Quick notes from today’s 45-min screen with Jamie (joined by Mina for last 15):

Summary: Strong systems intuition, good practical experience with optimizing inference pipelines. Articulated quantization tradeoffs well. Experience level maps to senior engineer.

Strengths:
- Clear ownership of performance regressions and root-cause analysis
- Familiar with batching and KV cache strategies we use
- Good communication and pragmatic debugging examples

Concerns / open questions:

Recommendation: Move to a short take-home (2–3 hour practical exercise) to evaluate implementation and code clarity. If that looks good, follow with onsite (2 interviews + system design).
